correctness.rationale: Regular simplex vertices v_i=(e_i−1/(d+1))/sqrt2 yield oriented roots (e_i−e_j)/sqrt2. Width is their maximum projection; root pairs have inner product <=1/2, with 2(d−1) half-angle neighbors per root, so only π/3-separated cap pairs overlap before t0=sqrt(2/3). For three distinct roots ||a+b+c||²<=6, implying common cap t<=sqrt(2/3), so inclusion-exclusion is exact through second order. Conditional spherical coordinates along normalized sum/difference of pair centers produce Q and J beta integrals; d=2 circle expression and d=3 Gauss–Bonnet lens. Tangency coordinates scale x=δ, y=sqrt(δ), yielding lens volume 8 κ_{d−2}/d*(4/sqrt3)^((d−2)/2)δ^(d/2), and normalized H pairs give claimed coefficient. Independent root enumeration d2..8 checked 1260 half-angle pairs and 5 d3 lens analytic-versus-integration values.
residual_risks: Tail formula only for t>=sqrt(2/3), d>=3 lower region excluded; asymptotic for fixed d, and numerical cases are not proof of all d.
